description: G1–G15 for the bounded native ARM64 and Metal graphics foundation. Release acceptance requires all gates on the exact candidate.
title: Phase 01 - Native Graphics Foundation

description: Develop independently authored interoperability tests and fixtures from public specifications. External emulator results may inform test selection. Xenora owns its Rust ARM64 runtime, decoder, typed IR, shader compiler and Metal backend. Emulator code, ports, decoder tables, internal metadata and platform-specific dependencies are outside scope.
title: Phase 02 - Ecosystem Integration

description:
Expand independently verified gfx1030 semantics, resource access, wave behavior and native offscreen drawing.

### Deferred engineering
- [#25](https://github.com/ranveersoni98/Xenora/issues/25) · Verify Wave64 pairing on native Metal. Exercise both halves, cross-half operations, asymmetric masks and barrier safety with 64-lane readback.
- [#27](https://github.com/ranveersoni98/Xenora/issues/27) · Translate bounded vertex and fragment fixtures. Define stage IO and interpolation from public specifications; verify exact offscreen pixels.
title: Phase 03 - Graphics Maturation

description:
Measure correctness-gated CPU, translation and GPU behavior under reproducible host conditions. Track capability and failure evidence.

### Deferred engineering
- [#33](https://github.com/ranveersoni98/Xenora/issues/33) · Measure Metal pipeline reuse and cache identity. Separate cold and warm timing; test cache invalidation and verify shared output expectations.
title: Phase 04 - Performance and Compatibility

description:
Grow the bounded interpreter and independently demonstrate ARM64 recompilation, with precise state and fault behavior.

### Deferred engineering
- [#40](https://github.com/ranveersoni98/Xenora/issues/40) · Choose first measured recompilation target. Use interpreter profiles to choose one bounded basic block and document precise state and fault requirements.
- [#41](https://github.com/ranveersoni98/Xenora/issues/41) · Execute one translated ARM64 guest basic block. Execute emitted ARM64 code natively, compare registers, flags, memory and traps with interpreter and independent vectors.
- [#42](https://github.com/ranveersoni98/Xenora/issues/42) · Verify code cache and executable memory policy. Validate mapping permissions, publication, invalidation and dependency provenance on macOS.
- [#43](https://github.com/ranveersoni98/Xenora/issues/43) · Measure ARM64 translation performance. Compare correctness-gated translated and interpreted inputs with matched native runs and resource records.
title: Phase 05 - CPU Recompilation

description:
Build isolated guest loading, memory, services and checked CPU-to-GPU commands using original inputs.

### Deferred engineering
- [#49](https://github.com/ranveersoni98/Xenora/issues/49) · Expand synthetic services and authorized runtime boundaries. Define explicit service ABI, faults and lifetimes with original inputs. Document evidence gaps for authentic Xbox platform contracts.

Future import behavior is tracked in [#55](https://github.com/ranveersoni98/Xenora/issues/55). Compatibility checks do not inspect user acquisition or ownership.
title: Phase 06 - Runtime Infrastructure

description: Validate the integrated execution path and exact release candidate. Project-run title testing requires suitable inputs and independent evidence. The loader evaluates format and compatibility without checking where user files came from.
title: Phase 07 - Integrated Validation
